description: Asked after a shirt, and was not given a side.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Measured the loaf, refused a verdict, and kept the three pence.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Kept the stool, and declined the end of the loaf.
name: Gib

description: Compared the walk to a shuttle, and went to his door.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Named forty lines and a sitting-down, and would not tell the plot.
name: William Shakespeare
